current_suggestion.pitch: You consume GTO content from Wizard and GTO Lab but Solve For Why — wait, this is on your exclusion list. Let me correct: Matt Berkey's channel covers the exploitative, live-game, population-reads side of poker that pure GTO channels systematically underweight, giving you the steelman for why solver outputs alone are insufficient at real tables. Format is a mix of hand breakdowns, solo theory, and roundtable discussion with high-stakes live players. The depth assumes a serious student and avoids beginner-padding.
